CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 AND et.currentDueDate < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 WHEN et.taskStatus IN (1, 3) AND ( (et.taskStatus = 3 AND et.currentDueDate < CURRENT_DATE) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task_action late_submission WHERE late_submission.taskId = et.taskId AND late_submission.actionType = 'SUBMIT' AND CAST(late_submission.actionTime AS DATE) > COALESCE( ( SELECT MAX(return_action.newDueDate) FROM task_action return_action WHERE return_action.taskId = et.taskId AND return_action.actionType = 'REJECT' AND return_action.actionTime < late_submission.actionTime ), et.baseDueDate ) ) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM emp_task et INNER JOIN employee e ON e.empId = et.empId INNER JOIN task_template tt ON tt.tplId = et.tplId

INSERT INTO emp_task( empId, tplId, assignedDept, baseDueDate, currentDueDate, currentSubmissionId, taskStatus, finishByAccountId, finishByName, finishTime, version ) VALUES
( #{item.empId}, #{item.tplId}, #{item.assignedDept}, #{item.baseDueDate}, #{item.currentDueDate}, #{item.currentSubmissionId}, #{item.taskStatus}, #{item.finishByAccountId}, #{item.finishByName}, #{item.finishTime}, #{item.version} )
mapper.select: SELECT taskId, empId, tplId, assignedDept, baseDueDate, currentDueDate, currentSubmissionId, taskStatus, finishByAccountId, finishByName, finishTime, version FROM emp_task WHERE taskId = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE emp_task SET currentSubmissionId = #{currentSubmissionId}, taskStatus = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE taskId = #{taskId} AND taskStatus IN (0, 3) AND version = #{version}

UPDATE emp_task SET taskStatus = 2, finishByAccountId = #{accountId}, finishByName = #{finishByName}, finishTime = #{finishTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE taskId = #{taskId} AND taskStatus = 1 AND version = #{version}
UPDATE emp_task SET taskStatus = 3, currentDueDate = #{newDueDate}, version = version + 1 WHERE taskId = #{taskId} AND taskStatus = 1 AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp_task WHERE empId = #{empId} AND taskStatus IN (0, 1, 3)

SELECT e.empId, e.empName, COUNT(et.taskId) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus IN (0, 1, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM() AS overdueCount FROM employee e LEFT JOIN emp_task et ON et.empId = e.empId LEFT JOIN task_template tt ON tt.tplId = et.tplId WHERE e.empId = #{empId} GROUP BY e.empId, e.empName
